tytul: Long-dried kabanosy: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for kabanosy dried for a long time (Polish kabanosy długo podsuszane).

ostrzezenia.tekst: UGA recommends cooking products made from ground pork and beef to an internal temperature of 160 °F.
According to UGA, a sausage is shelf stable only when its water activity is below 0.85 and its pH is under 5.3.
Too much nitrate or nitrite can be toxic to people.

akapity: JarAtlas has no home method to measure water activity or pH.
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for long-dried kabanosy from a checked source.
